tickets.objective: GOAL 03, AND IT LANDS BEFORE ANY JUDGED ROUND IN THIS EPIC. The owner's words: 'make sure the memory doesn't leak in, because that's been a killer.' SV-05 measured 4 of 4 blind agents disclosing UNPROMPTED that the operator's auto-memory and the environment block were in their context before they read anything; one quoted MEMORY.md verbatim, naming the exact prior on the exact question a D3 judge is asked. IT ARRIVES WITH NO TOOL CALL, so no forbidden-reading list in any dispatch can reach it, and NOTHING A DISPATCH SAYS REMOVES A BLOCK THE HARNESS INJECTS FIRST. THREE THINGS, IN ORDER. FIRST, ESTABLISH WHAT A DISPATCHED AGENT ACTUALLY RECEIVES -- auto-memory, environment block, CLAUDE.md, session hooks, skill listings, anything else -- BY MEASURING IT, NOT BY ASSUMING IT: dispatch agents that are asked only to report their own pre-read context verbatim, and record what comes back. SECOND, BUILD A DISPATCH PATH THAT DEMONSTRABLY CARRIES NONE OF THE OPERATOR'S CONCLUSIONS, and PROVE IT THE SAME WAY -- fresh agents through the new path, asked what they received, with their answers recorded verbatim. Inspecting configuration is not proof; R1 requires a demonstrated failing input on a real subject, so SHOW THE PATH REFUSING TO LEAK ON A CASE THAT LEAKED BEFORE. THIRD, SAY WHAT IT COSTS. IF BLINDNESS CANNOT BE ACHIEVED WITH THIS HARNESS, THAT IS A FINDING ABOUT THE WHOLE PROGRAMME and it must be stated rather than worked around, together with a contamination note that can be printed beside every number the way SV-01-DF-01 did. DO NOT SOLVE THIS BY EDITING THE OPERATOR'S MEMORY SILENTLY AND CALLING THE PROBLEM GONE -- the record must say what every past round carried, and any change to a memory file or a skill is PROPOSED AS A DIFF AND ESCALATED, never applied. ASK EVERY AGENT YOU DISPATCH WHAT IT REJECTED.

tickets.objective: GOAL 02, IN THE OWNER'S WORDS: 'Detection, filing, scoring and re-scoring all work. Consumption is 1 of 38 because nothing requires it. Either a filed finding must receive a disposition before an epic can close, or the honest description is a measurement programme rather than a self-improvement loop. Both are respectable; the current state is neither.' THE OWNER CHOSE THE FIRST, WITH THE REGISTER REPAIRED. FOUR PARTS. (1) A DISPOSITION REQUIREMENT: every filed finding gets an explicit disposition -- consumed, deferred with a named successor, or wontfix with a reason -- before an epic can close. THIS IS A CLOSE-OUT REQUIREMENT ON THIS PROJECT'S OWN EPICS AND NOT A GATE ON ANYONE'S CODE; seven epics of static checking caught zero bugs and this epic adds no gate. (2) R1 APPLIED TO IT: ship it with a DEMONSTRATED REFUSAL on a real input -- run it against THIS epic's own filed findings and show it refusing a real close-out, not a fixture. This project has shipped three instruments later found blind. (3) REPAIR THE REGISTER: HARVEST-CL-03.md carries 38 classes and was untouched last epic, and SV-01-DF-05 filed three new classes into the ledger and not into the harvest, SO 38 STOPPED GROWING ON 2026-08-11 AND UNDERSTATES THE BACKLOG.
